key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the threefold creation formula; the time/delay range is noted.
key_decisions.before: and swore by the one who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it, that there would be no more delay,
key_decisions.after: and swore by the one who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, earth and everything in it, and sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay.

key_decisions.rationale: Renders the proleptic completion in context without changing its certainty and preserves slaves/prophets.
key_decisions.before: but that in the days of the trumpet call to be sounded by the seventh angel, the mystery of God would be fulfilled, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.
key_decisions.after: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, God's mystery will be completed, just as he announced the good news to his slaves the prophets.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but that in the days of the trumpet call to be sounded by the seventh angel, the mystery of God would be fulfilled, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the plural they without naming speakers and preserves all four groups.
key_decisions.before: And I was told, “You must again prophesy about many peoples and nations and languages and kings.”
key_decisions.after: They said to me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I was told, “You must again prophesy about many peoples and nations and languages and kings.”
